rationale: Four factors from a 456-candidate published-library search whose ten-name book remained net-positive after 30bps costs on the untouched test window. A deflated Sharpe test at that trial count returns consistent_with_luck, so this record exists to settle the question with data that did not exist when the rules were written.
scoringRule: Book return over the holding period, minus the eligible-universe mean over the same period. Cost is charged on realised turnover at the frozen rate.
